question: What is the average elevation of the Eastern Ghats of India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**600 metres**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The average elevation of the **Eastern Ghats** of India is approximately **600 metres**.
 
• The Eastern Ghats are a discontinuous range of mountains along India's eastern coast.
 
• They run from the state of West Bengal in the north, through Odisha and Andhra Pradesh, to Tamil Nadu in the south.</
